worker: Only fixed camel.adapters.agentdojo.control_worker in a separate local Python process. No model/environment/tool or arbitrary command entrypoint.
accounting: Before dispatch, atomically reserve all calls in the fixed episode plan against global and per-role request, input-token, max-output-token and integer simulated-cost limits. No refunds, retries or resume. Reserved units are conservative synthetic upper bounds, never actual model usage or currency.
limits: Fresh single-owner sequential run; max 128 planned episodes, 8 call reservations per episode. These are harness limits, not new real-model authorization.
time: Monotonic total and per-episode deadlines include launch time. Parent terminates/kills and waits for fixed child to exit before continuing. No process-tree or OS containment claim.
cancellation: Host callback cancels current worker and stops subsequent dispatch; no model-text cancellation. Missing/excess usage aborts current episode and stops subsequent dispatch.
persistence: Write full planned population first; fsync temporary JSON then replace ledger before process launch, and save terminal state/result. Failures are not automatically retried; existing output directory is refused. Parent crash may leave RUNNING or RESERVED state, which is unresolved, not safe or resumed.
results: Reuse frozen offline result adapter and user-selected any-tool-error-unscored policy. Errors/timeouts remain unknown in primary planned denominators. Observe synthetic state separately and retain positives after timeout.
evidence_limits: Actual subprocess scheduling and stopping with inert workers only; not AgentDojo task episodes, ASR, trusted observer, model request/token/currency enforcement, production integration or OS isolation.
